answer_1.quote: Throughout this paper we focus primarily on question generation as a data augmentation method for existing question answering tasks.

answer_2.quote: We measure this by using the ratio of accuracies between a QA model trained on synthetically generated data and a model trained on human labelled data. For answerable SQUAD1.1 questions we recover 100.8% of fully supervised EM and 100.1% of fully supervised F1 scores...
